audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, bright electronic pop track featuring heavy synth bass and crisp electronic percussion. A high-pitched 'pop' SFX triggers as the man places the blanket. (2) A transition whoosh leads into multiple voices speaking in quick succession. Speech is fast and energetic, typical of a variety show. (3) A loud 'ding' SFX marks the appearance of text on screen. Background laughter from a small group is heard under the main narration. (4) During the gifting scene, the music swells slightly. A rustling sound of plastic and cardboard is audible as the box opens. (5) A series of comic 'boing' and 'squeak' SFX accompany the reaction shots of the man in the wig. (6) The blooper section features unedited studio noise, louder spontaneous laughter, and the speaker tripping over words followed by the sound of him hitting the desk lightly. The BGM remains consistent but slightly lowered in the mix.
